steps.en: Install it from the official cask and launch it
steps.zh: 用官方 cask 安装并启动

steps.en: Locates your brew binary and runs every command through /bin/zsh with a clean environment
steps.zh: 定位你的 brew，用 /bin/zsh 干净环境执行每条命令

steps.en: Search the catalogue and pick a package to install
steps.zh: 在目录里搜索并挑一个包安装

steps.en: Runs the real brew command and streams that command line plus its output into the Console
steps.zh: 跑真正的 brew，把命令行与输出流式打进 Console

steps.en: Refreshes the installed inventory and dependency graph so the package shows as installed
steps.zh: 刷新已安装清单与依赖图，让该包显示为已安装

value.en: Package management without the terminal, with every Homebrew operation still visible in a console you can copy from
value.zh: 不用终端也能装包，而且每一步 Homebrew 操作都能在可复制的控制台里看见

sources: ARCHITECTURE.md Command execution (SerialBrewCommandCenter, copyable Terminal commands, parsing-only flags omitted)
ARCHITECTURE.md Data and storage (installed repository owns the inventory and dependency graph, refresh after mutations)
